description: One period of HMRC's Self Employment Business API from the loaded self-employed book: the period's own figures in a tax year filed as dated period summaries, a running total from 6 April in a year filed as cumulative period summaries (2025-26 on). Picks the period by periodEndDate among the year's four (standard quarters by default); with no periodEndDate answers every period. A field the book cannot source is omitted, never sent as zero.

periodEndDate.description: The period's end date, YYYY-MM-DD, as HMRC's obligation names it

quarterlyPeriodType.description: standard (6 April quarters, the default) or calendar

taxYear.description: Override the tax year the book's dates imply, as 2025-26

name: derive_itsa_quarterly_update
title: Derive an ITSA quarterly update
